'''Magister Salorn''' is a human found at the [[Rogue Heights]] in [[Tirisfal Glades]]. Magister Salorn leads a group of alleged Rogue Wizards as part of a covert [[Kirin Tor]] group checking the Forsaken in their expansion within the [[Tirisfal Uplands]].<ref>{{questlong|Horde|20+|Magical Interference}}</ref>

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Salorn's Ring]] for {{questlong|Horde|20+|Magical Interference}}.
